items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026, late afternoon IST (gaggle before Youngstown, Ohio rally)
items.title: Trump: midterms won't sway Iran strategy; war 'will end very soon'; Houthis 'misbehaving very badly'
items.summary: Speaking to reporters Monday before his Youngstown, Ohio rally, Trump said the Nov 3 midterms will not influence US strategy toward Iran and repeated that the war 'will end very soon' (with oil prices to 'drop like a rock'). He confirmed he spoke directly with Saudi Crown Prince MBS about Houthi airport attacks; asked about a US response to the Houthis, he said only they are 'misbehaving very badly' and announced no retaliatory measures.

items.event_time_ist: Oct 13, 2026, ~7:50 AM IST (Youngstown, Ohio rally, evening Oct 12 ET)
items.title: Trump says US 'might have gone too far' targeting Iran's leadership; claims all 159 Iranian naval vessels sunk
items.summary: At the Youngstown, Ohio campaign rally, Trump said the US may have 'gone too far' in targeting Iran's leadership — 'we don't know who the hell we're dealing with any more' — complicating negotiations. He also reiterated the claim that Iran has lost its air force and all 159 naval vessels, now 'resting beautifully in the bottom of the sea'.
items.source_name: The Business Standard (TBS) / Rifnote (via Al Jazeera)
